items.docs: Returns current portfolio metrics for the authenticated account: margin balance, net invested, PnL, volume metrics, and Sharpe ratios (when enabled and sufficient data).

params.name: range
params.description: Time range for bucketing: 7d (default), 24h, 30d, or all

items.docs: Returns time-series portfolio snapshots for the authenticated account. Optional query parameter `range` controls the bucket size: 7d (default), 24h, 30d, or all.
